title: Pair Sum Target
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

title: Reverse Words in String
statement: Given an input string s, reverse the order of the words. A word is defined as a sequence of non-space characters. The words in s should be returned separated by a single space.

title: Detect Duplicate Elements
statement: Given an integer array nums, return True if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return False if every element is distinct.

title: Valid Alpha Palindrome
statement: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward.

title: Anagram Verification
statement: Given two strings s and t, return True if t is an anagram of s, and False otherwise. An anagram is formed by rearranging the letters of another word using all original letters once.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum (Kadane's algorithm).

title: Nth Fibonacci Term
statement: Compute the Nth Fibonacci number where F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, and F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) for n > 1.

title: Recursive Digit Sum
statement: Given a non-negative integer n, recursively calculate and return the sum of its individual digits.

title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
statement: You are given two integer arrays nums1 and nums2, both sorted in non-decreasing order. Merge both into a single sorted list and return it.

title: Bubble Sort Implementation
statement: Implement bubble sort to sort an integer array in ascending order in-place or returning a new list.

title: Most Frequent Element
statement: Given an array of integers nums, find and return the integer that occurs most frequently. If there are ties, return the smallest integer.

title: Recursive Exponentiation
statement: Implement pow(base, exp) using recursion to compute base raised to the non-negative integer power exp.
